title: Eleventh Station: Jesus is Nailed to the Cross
text:
Consider how Jesus, after being thrown on the Cross, extended His hands and offered to His Eternal Father the sacrifice of His life for our salvation. These barbarians fastened Him with nails, and then, raising the Cross, allowed Him to die with anguish.

My Jesus, let my mind and my heart be always at the foot of
the Cross so as to never forget the love Thou hast given me
and the sacrifice Thou hast paid for me.
I love Thee, my Jesus; I love Thee more than myself; I am sorry
for having offended Thee. Never let me stray from Thee again.
Grant that I may always love Thee and do Thy will. Amen.
notes: Text as distributed in the 'Catholic Prayers' Android app (richarddean.angeles.catholicprayers).
